operator_interventions.reason: Explicitly authorized merge and workahead through every planned phase and asked for return only when the final phase was reached.
operator_interventions.effect: Phase 5 implementation and merge are pre-authorized after acceptance validation, but the newly generated post-plan improvement is outside that completed phase sequence and remains at REVIEW.

review_events.gate: Phase 5 final planned implementation and merge
review_events.rationale: Operator pre-authorized the planned Phase 5 workahead and merge, and all Phase 5 acceptance validation passes.
The system generated LE-IMPROVE-dbfc7509df5b19c7 from recurring retained evidence, but generation does not authorize execution and the planned workahead ends at Phase 5.

friction: The execution environment used for ad hoc local verification has no outbound GitHub DNS/network access, so authoritative validation continued through the repository's GitHub Actions regression gate instead of a local clone.
The v0.1 improvement miner intentionally uses explicit lexical rules rather than semantic clustering, so registry coverage must expand through reviewed evidence rather than implicit model inference.

reusable_learnings.learning: A self-improving environment can be made auditable by mining only explicit retained operational signals through versioned patterns, requiring recurrence across executions, and separating proposal generation from execution authority.
Retained improvement analyses should be exactly reproducible from canonical receipts and a versioned pattern registry so the operator can audit why a recommendation existed at a point in time.

The first recurring high-leverage bottleneck detected from real retained history is context candidate recall: improve retrieval upstream while preserving the existing deterministic Context Compiler as the admission boundary.

reused_experience.statement: Build the Phase 5 environment-improvement loop that mines retained friction, failures, exclusions, routing abstentions, and reusable learning for recurring structural bottlenecks, produces an evidence-backed improvement proposal, and never self-authorizes the resulting change.
reused_experience.application: Phase 5 implemented an explicit-signal recurrence miner and governed REVIEW-only proposal contract over validated retained receipts.
reused_experience.observed_effect: The system produced a reproducible proposal from real retained history while leaving execution_authorized false and stopping at REVIEW.

reused_experience.statement: Executor identity needs an explicit stable capability toolset distinct from incidental validation and observability tools; otherwise performance history fragments across operationally equivalent runs.
reused_experience.application: The Phase 5 registry includes executor identity as a candidate category, but the analyzer correctly leaves it ineligible because the signal currently recurs within only one distinct execution rather than lowering the recurrence threshold to force selection.
reused_experience.observed_effect: A plausible high-leverage improvement remains unselected until additional independent execution evidence accumulates.

residual_risks: Improvement matching is lexical and registry-bound in v0.1; relevant novel failure language will produce no candidate until a reviewed pattern is added.

The analyzer measures recurrence, not whether a historical issue was subsequently remediated; future iterations need resolution/supersession status for improvement candidates to avoid resurfacing already-fixed problems.
The selected context-relevance proposal improves candidate retrieval only; no retrieval implementation has been authorized or built yet.
The Graph Engineering OS browser prototype still does not consume the canonical context, routing, or improvement records directly.
